data.transcript:
WEBVTT


00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:01.580
Hard being the son of an of model.

00:00:01.581 --> 00:00:04.221
You go to school and get shown a clip of your mom getting cracked.

00:00:04.222 --> 00:00:05.461
You cry, they laugh.

00:00:05.462 --> 00:00:07.181
Your mom never thought about the repercussions

00:00:07.182 --> 00:00:08.701
of her need to make money fast.

00:00:08.702 --> 00:00:10.581
She thought it would empower you if you had money.

00:00:10.582 --> 00:00:12.141
Money was supposed to be worth at all.

00:00:12.142 --> 00:00:14.821
But no money in the world can buy back a normal childhood.

00:00:14.822 --> 00:00:16.021
No allowance is large enough

00:00:16.022 --> 00:00:18.521
to make middle schoolers suddenly develop empathy.

00:00:18.580 --> 00:00:20.140
A luxury vacation is gonna erase

00:00:20.141 --> 00:00:21.781
the moment somebody pulls out their phone

00:00:21.782 --> 00:00:23.581
with a video of your mom getting railed.

00:00:23.582 --> 00:00:25.661
You inherit a problem you never signed up for.

00:00:25.662 --> 00:00:27.021
A decision made by an adult

00:00:27.022 --> 00:00:28.581
becomes a permanent part of your life

00:00:28.582 --> 00:00:30.221
before you're old enough to understand it.

00:00:30.222 --> 00:00:32.901
And the cruel part is that you're the one paying social interest

00:00:32.902 --> 00:00:34.861
on somebody else's financial decision.

00:00:34.862 --> 00:00:36.381
Your mom saw a monthly payout.

00:00:36.382 --> 00:00:37.741
You got a lifetime subscription

00:00:37.742 --> 00:00:39.021
to be reminded about it

00:00:39.022 --> 00:00:41.421
while wearing an Azerbaijan Technology Camel tee.

00:00:41.422 --> 00:00:44.521
Get yours at childrenofkhan com. Link in bio.
